entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, agent ID 302. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I, uh, I need to make a return and I just feel terrible about it. I hope this is okay.
I'm sorry to hear you're not completely satisfied, but of course I can help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Yes, the name is Sarah Miller, order number is VF778-12. It's for the Urban Commuter Helmet.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling that up now... I see the order. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a preference thing. I was so excited, but the online pictures made the color look different. When it arrived, it just wasn't right. The box is still unopened, it's just been sitting here. Honestly, I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time and I really needed this money back for another expense. I feel so guilty for even calling.

Please don't feel guilty at all, Sarah. We want you to be 100% happy with your gear. The most important thing is your safety, and that starts with having a helmet you feel great about wearing. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you.
Okay, I see the delivery was 43 days ago. Our policy for standard items like this helmet is 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can absolutely approve this return for you right now.
Oh, really? That's... such a relief. I was so worried it would be a problem. Thank you so much.

Of course. And I see here you're one of our VIP customers, so thank you for that loyalty. I've just gone ahead and emailed you a prepaid return shipping label to make this as easy as possible. There's no cost to you.
Wow, I wasn't expecting that. That's incredibly kind. You've really helped me out today.

It's my pleasure. Just print the label, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, your full refund will be processed in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Alex.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Have a great day, and ride safely.
